mapper.sql:
WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND use_yn = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'TRASH' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
AND (snippet_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR snippet_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR snippet_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND snippet_language = #{language}
AND favorite_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT developer_snippet_id, member_id, snippet_title, snippet_description, snippet_language, snippet_code, CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) AS tags_json, favorite_yn, use_yn, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM developer_snippets WHERE developer_snippet_id = #{snippetId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO developer_snippets (member_id, snippet_title, snippet_description, snippet_language, snippet_code, tags_json, favorite_yn) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{snippetTitle}, #{snippetDescription}, #{snippetLanguage}, #{snippetCode}, CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON), #{favoriteYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE developer_snippets SET snippet_title = #{snippetTitle}, snippet_description = #{snippetDescription}, snippet_language = #{snippetLanguage}, snippet_code = #{snippetCode}, tags_json = CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON), favorite_yn = #{favoriteYn} WHERE developer_snippet_id = #{developerSnippetId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE developer_snippets SET use_yn = 'N', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE developer_snippet_id = #{snippetId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE developer_snippets SET use_yn = 'Y', deleted_at = NULL WHERE developer_snippet_id = #{snippetId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND use_yn = 'N'
